style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF1F7;strokeColor=#C586AA;fontSize=13;fontFamily=Arial;fontColor=#172033;spacing=8;" value="<b>내부 색 K_N</b><br>seed 거리·강도 → 글자형 색 에너지<br>palette 적용 style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EEF8F4;strokeColor=#6B9E89;fontSize=13;fontFamily=Arial;fontColor=#172033;spacing=8;" value="<b>최종 화면 Frame_N</b><br><font color="#397C65">composite(M_N, C_N, K_N)</font><br>실루엣 밖: 현재 글자<br>실루엣 안: 내부 색" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="280" x="1240" y="150" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="contact-spring" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F4F0FF;strokeColor=#8C79BD;fontSize=13;fontFamily=Arial;fontColor=#172033;spacing=8;" value="<b>글자 접촉 + 감쇠 스프링</b><br>C_N × M_N을 9 × 9 위치에서 검사<br>glyph 경계 + 현재 S_N으로 검사점 배치<br>접촉 최댓값 → 목표 하강 거리<br>좌우 차이 → 목표 회전각" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="280" x="1240" y="440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="spring-next" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F5F7FA;strokeColor=#AEBCCD;fontSize=13;fontFamily=Arial;fontColor=#172033;spacing=8;" value="<b>다음 spring 상태 S_(N+1)</b><br>새 offset · velocity<br>새 angle · angular velocity" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="280" x="1240" y="680" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
